title: Ruqsat ka Waqt
body:
shabbir ro rahe hai zainab bhi ro rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye kaisa hassan ka hai
teeron ke sayeban mein janaza hassan ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab hai nauhakhan hai to girya kuna hussain
ye kitna sogwaar gharana hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kya aaj tak suni kisi mayyat ki waapsi
bas ek janaza laut ke aaya hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo zehr e halahal diya jauda ne hassan ko
tukdon mein usne baata kaleja hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab pachaade khaati hai farwa ke bain se
kulsoom ki zaban pe nauha hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ko kamsini hi mein hona pada yateem
ye kehke khoon rota gharana hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
zehr e dagha se jism ki rangat badal gayi
chehra bhi haath paon bhi neela hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
tanha hassan ka ghar se janaza utha magar
socho to aaj saath mein nana hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurbat ke hai hisaar mein farwa ka noor e ain
qasim ke sar pe ab kahan saaya hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
<<DIVIDER>>
lafzon mein uska ho nahi sakta bayan kabhi
khadim ke dil mein aaj jo sadma hassan ka hai
ruqsat ka waqt dekhiye...
author: Khadim
